corpusPurpose: Approved project-contract retrieval fixture. It contains copied public product-contract excerpts, not personal-vault or donor-repository data.

chunks.text: Build a launchable, fully native Apple-silicon macOS application that gives one person a single, quiet front door to their knowledge, projects, research, Mac, and specialized tools.
The application stays genuinely useful without CAM, the network, cloud credentials, or any optional module.
Layer 1 — Personal Trust and Memory: Native SwiftUI experience, local vault, capture, durable storage, retrieval, privacy policy, audit, tasks, receipts, and backups.

Raw vault material, API keys, credentials, private keys, regulated data, personal identifiers, and proprietary context remain local unless an exact outbound policy has produced an approved, scrubbed payload.
Repository intelligence is a first-class source-acquisition capability, not a hidden side effect of chat.
An idea card is a candidate, never an instruction to copy code, alter a repository, or represent an unverified claim as product truth.
Exact approved action: CAM mining, file mutation, Mac apply/undo, network spend requires exact approval bound to action, target, payload digest, state, expiry, and rollback.
No model output, CAM result, mined repository content, web result, or optional reflector can upgrade itself from one authority level to another.

One quiet assistant can remember, retrieve, research, coordinate, maintain the Mac, and invoke specialized tools without surrendering ownership of personal data or forcing the user to manage separate systems.
